title: Memory leak hunt
intro: Something is slowly eating memory, but it isn't the biggest pod. Find the pod whose memory keeps growing.
hints: The biggest pod isn't necessarily the leaking one. Look at growth, not size.
delta(memory_bytes[1h]) shows how much each pod grew in the last hour.
solution: delta(memory_bytes[1h]): frontend-1 grew about 18 MiB in the last hour while the others stayed flat.
debrief: Leaks are about the trend, not the level. delta() over a long window (or deriv() and predict_linear() in real Prometheus) shows them clearly.
